note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/bill-of-lading records, not by website claims: 5 concrete rows seen on 2025-10-01 ex-JNPT to Mombasa (Kenya) for a DR Congo consignee, with B/L numbers 8551051, 6930683, 7611798, 6002600, 9121191. Source counter says 67 shipments total but only 5 rows were visible in the free view — the remaining ~62 rows are behind the paywall and were NOT verified. Declared HS 841319 (pumps for liquids) does not match any observed line: actual codes seen are 27101990 (lubricating oils/greases, 2 rows), 82055910 (hand tools/grease guns, 2 rows) and 84254200 (hydraulic jacks, 1 row). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes (primary 27101990 for the lubricant trade, with 82055910/84254200 for the tooling lines) and the verdict is accepted_hs_corrected. The claimed industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is only loosely consistent: the company ships mining/workshop consumables (greases, grease guns, bottle jacks) to an artisanal-mining region in DR Congo, but it is a lubricant/tools trader-exporter, not a metallurgical producer. Role: appears to be trader/exporter of own-brand 'Durelo' goods rather than a manufacturer — manufacturer status not verified. Domestic supply: no evidence found either way; recorded as unknown, not as 'conditionally accepted'. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view shows shipment counts only, no values, and no figures were invented.
